sources.name: SOCFortress Playbooks attachment
sources.use: Six selected IRP README files are normalized into playbooks.json; empty/generic product files, templates, images and repository-only material are excluded from runtime RAG.

sources.name: NIST SP 800-61r3 attachment
sources.use: Selected incident-analysis, correlation, impact/scope, prioritization and playbook guidance is normalized into nist_ir.json.

sources.name: Sigma Rules detection catalog
sources.use: Eighty candidate Windows security and system event IDs with compiled Sigma detection signatures normalized into sigma_rules.json.

sources.name: CABTA attachment
sources.use: Architecture reference for modular agents, bounded ReAct-style control flow, separation of concerns and fail-safe behavior; its application/web code is not bundled into the SOC core.

sources.name: Microsoft Learn shortcut attachment
sources.use: Authoritative vendor domain. scripts/update_event_ids_from_microsoft.py performs live page verification when internet access is available.

sources.name: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise Matrix
sources.use: Curated core enterprise techniques with LOLBAS, OWASP, and D3FEND cross-references normalized into mitre_attack.json for runtime TTP grounding.
